```{r}
# Define path
data_dir <- "/Users/sriyarajyam/Documents/data"

# List subdirectories
sample_folders <- list.dirs(data_dir, full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)

# Sample names
sample_names <- basename(sample_folders)

# Load function (as you had it)
load_sample <- function(sample_path) {
  sample_name <- basename(sample_path)
  matrix_path <- file.path(sample_path, "matrix.mtx.gz")
  features_path <- file.path(sample_path, "features.tsv.gz")
  barcodes_path <- file.path(sample_path, "barcodes.tsv.gz")
  
  expression_matrix <- ReadMtx(mtx = matrix_path, features = features_path, cells = barcodes_path)
  seurat_obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = expression_matrix, project = sample_name)
  seurat_obj$sample <- sample_name
  seurat_obj[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat_obj, pattern = "^MT-")
  return(seurat_obj)
}

# Load and name
seurat_list <- setNames(lapply(sample_folders, load_sample), sample_names)

```

```{r}
seurat_list
```


```{r}
# Find the intersection of features across all samples
common_features <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(seurat_list, rownames))

# Subset each Seurat object to retain only common features
seurat_list <- lapply(seurat_list, function(obj) {
  obj <- subset(obj, features = common_features)
  return(obj)
})

# Merge all Seurat objects
integrated_seurat <- merge(seurat_list[[1]], y = seurat_list[-1], add.cell.ids = basename(sample_folders))

```

```{r}
# Apply QC filtering
integrated_seurat <- subset(integrated_seurat, 
                            subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 8000 & 
                                     nCount_RNA > 1000 & nCount_RNA < 40000 & 
                                     percent.mt < 5)
integrated_seurat
```


```{r}
# Normalize Data
integrated_seurat <- NormalizeData(integrated_seurat, name="RNA")

# Identify Variable Features
integrated_seurat <- FindVariableFeatures(integrated_seurat, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 1500)

top10 <- head(VariableFeatures(integrated_seurat), 10)
plot1 <- VariableFeaturePlot(integrated_seurat)
plot2 <- LabelPoints(plot = plot1, points = top10, repel = TRUE)
plot1 + plot2

# cale Data & Run PCA
integrated_seurat <- ScaleData(integrated_seurat)
integrated_seurat <- RunPCA(integrated_seurat)
integrated_seurat <- RunHarmony(integrated_seurat, "sample")

# Find Neighbors
integrated_seurat <- FindNeighbors(integrated_seurat, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:10)
```

```{r}
# Run clustering at multiple resolutions for optimization
resolutions <- seq(1.0, 1.6, by = 0.1)
for (res in resolutions) {
  integrated_seurat <- FindClusters(integrated_seurat, resolution = res)
}

# Visualize clustering results at different resolutions
clustree(integrated_seurat, prefix = "RNA_snn_res.")
```


```{r}
# Choose best resolution (0.6 based on Clustree)
optimal_res <- 1.4
integrated_seurat <- FindClusters(integrated_seurat, resolution = optimal_res)

# Run UMAP for Visualization
integrated_seurat <- RunUMAP(integrated_seurat, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:10)

# Plot UMAP with Sample Labels & Clusters
p1 <- DimPlot(integrated_seurat, reduction = "umap", group.by = "sample") + ggtitle("UMAP by Sample")
p2 <- DimPlot(integrated_seurat, reduction = "umap", group.by = "seurat_clusters") + ggtitle("UMAP by Clusters")
p1 + p2
```

```{r}
seurat.new <- RenameIdents(integrated_seurat,
                                `0` = "T-Cells",
                                `1` = "NK Cells",
                                `2` = "T-Cells",
                                `3` = "Macrophages",
                                `4` = "Monocytes",
                                `5` = "Macrophages",
                                `6` = "Fibroblasts",
                                `7` = "Fibroblasts",
                                `8` = "Monocytes",
                                `9` = "Melanocytes",
                                `10` = "B-Cells") 

seurat.new$CellType <- Idents(seurat.new)

seurat.new.plot <- seurat.new

DefaultAssay(seurat.new.plot) <- "RNA"

 #Reorder cell types by similarity
 Idents(seurat.new.plot) <- factor(
   Idents(seurat.new.plot), 
   levels = c('T-Cells',  
              'NK Cells',
              'B-Cells',
              'Macrophages',  
              'Monocytes',  
              'Fibroblasts',  
              'Melanocytes'  
              )
 )
markers.to.plot <- c(
  'CD3D', 'CD3E', 'IL32', # T cells
  'NKG7', 'GNLY', 'GZMA', 'PRF1',  # Natural killer cells
  'MS4A1', 'CD79A', 'CD74',  # B cells
  'F13A1', 'CD163', 'AIF1',  # macrophages
  'LYN', 'VCAN', 'LYZ', 'FCGR3A', 'FCN1',  # Monocytes
  #'CD163', 'CSF1R',  # Monocyte-derived macrophages
  'FBLN1', 'RARRES1', 'IGF2',  # Fibroblasts
  #'ACTA2', 'TPM2', 'TAGLN', 'MYL9',  # Smooth muscle cells
  'TRPM1', 'MLANA', 'PMEL' #cluster 9
)

seurat.new.plot@active.ident <- factor(seurat.new.plot@active.ident, 
                            levels=rev(c('T-Cells',  
              'NK Cells',
              'B-Cells',
              'Macrophages',  
              'Monocytes',  
              'Fibroblasts',  
              'Melanocytes' )))

# Generate DotPlot with new ordering
DotPlot(seurat.new.plot, 
        features = markers.to.plot, 
        cols = c("blue", "red"), 
        scale = FALSE) +  
        xlab("") + 
        ylab("") +
        scale_size_area(limits = c(0, 100), max_size = 4) +
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size=10), 
              axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
              legend.key.size = unit(0.5, 'cm'),  
              legend.title = element_text(size=10),
              legend.text = element_text(size=10) )

```

```{r}
# Make sure you're working with the full RNA assay
DefaultAssay(seurat_obj) <- "RNA"

# Check that the counts slot exists
slotNames(seurat_obj[["RNA"]])
# Should show: "counts" "data" "scale.data"

# -------------------------------
# 3. Convert Seurat → AnnData
# -------------------------------
# This step exports your full counts matrix, metadata, and reductions
adata <- as_AnnData(
  seurat_obj,
  assay = "RNA",      # which Seurat assay to use
  layer = "counts"    # ensures all genes (raw counts) are exported
)

# -------------------------------
# 4. (Optional) Add normalized & scaled matrices as layers
# -------------------------------
# These will appear as adata.layers['normalized'] and ['scaled'] in Scanpy
adata$layers[["normalized"]] <- t(GetAssayData(woopity_obj, slot = "data"))
#adata$layers[["scaled"]] <- t(GetAssayData(woopity_obj, slot = "scale.data"))

# -------------------------------
# 5. Write to h5ad file
# -------------------------------
write_h5ad(adata, path = "aqueous.h5ad")

# -------------------------------
# 6. Verify inside R (optional)
# -------------------------------
adata
# Expected output:
# AnnData object with n_obs × n_vars = [cells × genes]
#     layers: 'counts', 'normalized', 'scaled'
#     obsm: 'X_pca', 'X_umap' (if present)
#     obs: your Seurat meta.data columns
```
